customManagers.description: The h5py floor users install, kept equal to the tested pin
The homeassistant pin follows pytest-homeassistant, which pins the HA of its own number and is published hours after it: tracking the plugin's versions moves the pin only once both exist

packageRules.description: One PR moves the manifest floor and the pyproject pins together
pytest-homeassistant pins the HA of its own number: one PR moves both pins (homeassistant through the custom manager), betas included, so the suite runs on a release before it is out
homeassistant moves with the custom manager: on its own PyPI versions it would be bumped before its test plugin exists
numpy follows HA's pin, not PyPI (see pyproject unit-test)
The docs site (website/): every Docusaurus package moves in one PR
